title: Development and application of coffee husk-based polyaniline composite (CF@PANi) for enhanced ammonium removal from aqueous solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13882-13895
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00949A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thuy-Tien Do, Huu-Tap Van, The-Duyen Nguyen, Thi-Huyen Nguyen, Xuan-Bach Nguyen
This study focuses on the development and evaluation of a novel composite material, designated as CF@PANi, which integrates coffee husk and polyaniline for the purpose of ammonium adsorption from aqueous solutions.
